Luna Park: hey everyone — I'm Luna (they/she), starting today on infra. previously at a tiny infra startup. night-cyclist, synthwave hobbyist, and proud owner of a tiny moon cactus :crescent_moon: :seedling:

Harper Lin: welcome!! i'll bring biscuits :cookie: and a tiny plant pot if you want to trade clippings :)
Kai Nakamura: +1 for 10am. quiet early-morning desks are usually in zone A5. FYI rooftop access needs a badge flag — i've pinged infra-ops to add you.
people-ops-bot: onboarding reminder for Luna Park — badge provisioning, laptop image, and payroll form are in progress. If anything is missing, mention @Noor.
Noor: added rooftop access and the new-hires Slack group. ping me if your laptop needs any adapters or special software.
Juniper: welcome Luna! there's a 10min devex intro at 11am if you want a quick tour of our dev tools and runbooks.

Harper Lin: see you tomorrow :thumbsup:
